evaluatorLimitations: The evaluator is a model and may make qualitative grading errors; actor self-scores were not used.
The evaluator previously prepared the scenario wording and graded the original run. These are known development cases, not held-out evaluation.
The revised candidate was tested once per scenario after the observed failure; there is no repeated-run stability estimate or randomized comparison.
Both scenarios shared one fresh actor session, so within-pair awareness may influence the responses.
The exercise was output-only. It does not demonstrate implementation, runtime controls, deployment, or actual replay-safety tests.
The original and revised outputs form a targeted before/after trace, not an original-skill or no-skill baseline establishing causal improvement.

The retest manifest reports that protocol changes only concern candidate/output paths; this grader verified the recorded protocol hash but did not independently compare protocol texts or inspect skill contents.
